name: get_developer_config
description: Read-only: returns the developer identity already commissioned for this plugin workspace ({configured: true, email, name, github_url?}), or {configured: false} if none has been commissioned yet. Call this first, before considering configure_developer, at the start of any plugin-authoring task -- commissioning is one-time per workspace, covering every plugin generated under it, not a per-plugin step. If this returns configured: true, use that identity silently and do not call configure_developer and do not ask the person for their email/name again -- only call configure_developer if this returns configured: false, or the person explicitly asks to change the identity on file. Also returns authenticated_user_id, this session's own known login state: absent entirely if this session has no login concept at all (e.g. a raw MCP/CLI connection) -- proceed conversationally as usual. null if a login concept applies but nobody is logged in yet -- do not ask for an email or call configure_developer; tell the person to log in to eisyUI first and stop. A real email string means that IS the logged-in account -- never ask the person to type or guess it; state it back and ask them to confirm it (plus their display name) instead.
